import re
import sys

text = sys.stdin.read()
values = {}

pattern = r"\b(TMP|a|b|c|d)\s*<-\s*(TMP|a|b|c|d|-?\d+)\b"

for destination, source in re.findall(pattern, text):
    values[destination] = values[source] if source in values else int(source)

print(
    f"a ?= {values['a']}; b ?= {values['b']}; "
    f"c ?= {values['c']}; d ?= {values['d']}; "
    f"TMP ?= {values['TMP']};"
)
